body.zh-Hant: 威廉二世生於1859年1月27日，是普魯士王子（後來的腓特烈三世皇帝）的第一個孩子。他的左臂在出生時受損，終身短縮、麻痺且畸形。1877年至1879年間，他在波昂大學修讀法學與國家學。1888年父親腓特烈三世去世後，他繼位為德意志皇帝與普魯士國王。
body.en: Wilhelm II was born on 27 January 1859, the first child of the Prussian prince who later became Emperor Friedrich III. His left arm was damaged at birth and remained permanently shortened, paralysed and misshapen. In 1877-79 he studied law and political science at the University of Bonn. After the death of his father Friedrich III in 1888 he succeeded as German Emperor and King of Prussia.

heading.zh-Hant: 俾斯麥去職與外交風波

body.zh-Hant: 1890年，威廉二世解除了首相俾斯麥的職務。1896年致布爾人領袖克魯格的賀電，使德英關係受到嚴重拖累。1905年他前往摩洛哥丹吉爾的訪問，依NDB說法，是聽從外交部、外交界與首相比洛方面的建議。
body.en: In 1890 Wilhelm II dismissed Chancellor Bismarck. The Kruger telegram of 1896, sent to the Boer leader, strained German-British relations considerably. According to the NDB, his demonstrative visit to Tangier in Morocco in 1905 followed suggestions from circles in the Foreign Office, the diplomatic service and Chancellor Bernhard von Bulow.

heading.zh-Hant: 每日電訊報事件到大戰前夕
heading.en: From the Daily Telegraph affair to July 1914

body.zh-Hant: 1908年的《每日電訊報》事件，被NDB稱為他統治期間最嚴重的危機，事涉他接受倫敦《每日電訊報》的訪談。1911年第二次摩洛哥危機中，他派砲艦前往摩洛哥。1914年7月6日至7日，他向奧匈保證在戰爭衝突時給予無保留的同盟忠誠。
body.en: The Daily Telegraph affair of 1908 is called by the NDB the most serious crisis of his reign, and involved an interview he gave to the London newspaper. In the Second Moroccan Crisis of 1911 he sent a gunboat to Morocco. On 6-7 July 1914 he assured Austria-Hungary of unrestricted loyalty to the alliance in case of armed conflict.

body.zh-Hant: NDB稱他是陸海軍的最高統帥，但他在大戰期間隱於軍事將領之後。1916年興登堡與魯登道夫進入第三最高陸軍指揮部後，他對軍事指導的影響日漸下降。1918年11月28日他正式退位，此前他已逃往荷蘭；1920年起住在多倫莊園，於1941年6月4日在多倫去世。
body.en: The NDB calls him supreme commander of army and navy, yet during the war he receded behind the generals. After Hindenburg and Ludendorff entered the Third Supreme Army Command in 1916, his influence on the military conduct of the war steadily fell. He formally abdicated on 28 November 1918, having fled to the Netherlands; from 1920 he lived at Haus Doorn, and died there on 4 June 1941.

body.zh-Hant: 弗朗茨·約瑟夫生於1830年8月18日，是大公弗朗茨·卡爾之子。1848年12月2日，伯父斐迪南一世遜位，他繼承皇位，成為奧地利皇帝。NDB寫道，他是在維也納革命被鎮壓之後登基的。
body.en: Franz Joseph was born on 18 August 1830, the eldest son of Archduke Franz Karl. On 2 December 1848 his uncle Ferdinand I abdicated and he became Emperor of Austria. The NDB says he ascended the throne after the Vienna revolution had been put down.

body.zh-Hant: 1859年奧地利在索爾費里諾戰敗，被迫讓出倫巴底。1866年7月3日，奧地利在柯尼格雷茨戰敗。1867年與匈牙利達成妥協，並於6月8日加冕為匈牙利國王。NDB說他自1867年起以君主立憲的形式統治。1879年奧地利與德意志帝國締結同盟。
body.en: In 1859 Austria lost at Solferino and had to cede Lombardy. On 3 July 1866 Austria was defeated at Koniggratz. In 1867 came the Compromise with Hungary, and on 8 June he was crowned King of Hungary. The NDB says that from 1867 he ruled as a constitutional monarch. In 1879 Austria concluded the Dual Alliance with the German Empire.

heading.zh-Hant: 併吞波赫與世界大戰前夕
heading.en: Bosnia annexation and the road to war

body.zh-Hant: 1907年1月26日，他接受帝國議會採行自由而平等選舉權的決議。1908年，奧地利併吞自1878年起由其管理的波士尼亞與赫塞哥維納，使局勢逼近戰爭邊緣。1914年6月28日王位繼承人斐迪南大公遇刺，7月28日他支持對塞爾維亞宣戰。
body.en: On 26 January 1907 he accepted the Reichsrat decision to introduce free and equal suffrage. In 1908 Austria annexed Bosnia and Herzegovina, which it had administered since 1878, bringing the monarchy to the brink of war. On 28 June 1914 the heir to the throne, Archduke Franz Ferdinand, was assassinated, and on 28 July Franz Joseph supported the declaration of war on Serbia.

body.zh-Hant: NDB形容他受無與倫比的責任感驅使，專注於處理繁重的日常公務與朝廷儀典。他於1916年11月21日在維也納近郊的美泉宮去世，LeMO稱此為68年統治的終結。
body.en: The NDB describes him as inspired by an unparalleled sense of duty, concentrating on a huge daily workload of files and court ceremony. He died on 21 November 1916 at Schonbrunn near Vienna, which LeMO describes as the end of a 68-year reign.

body.zh-Hant: 尼古拉二世於1868年5月18日（舊曆5月6日）生於皇村，是亞歷山大三世的長子。1894年11月1日父親去世後他繼位為沙皇，同年11月26日與黑森-達姆施塔特的亞歷山德拉公主成婚。1896年的加冕慶典上，霍登卡廣場發生踩踏，近1400人死亡。
body.en: Nicholas II was born on 18 May 1868 (6 May old style) at Tsarskoye Selo, the eldest son of Alexander III. After his father died on 1 November 1894 he became tsar, and on 26 November he married Princess Alexandra of Hesse-Darmstadt. At the 1896 coronation festivities a crush on Khodynka field killed nearly 1,400 people.

body.zh-Hant: 1904年2月9日日俄戰爭爆發。1905年1月9日（舊曆）冬宮前的遊行遭軍隊開火，血腥星期日約造成200人死亡。同年10月17日，他在革命壓力下頒布十月詔書，引入基本權利與杜馬。1906年4月25日他在第一屆杜馬召開前頒布國家根本法；1907年6月3日解散新選的杜馬，並縮限選舉權。
body.en: The Russo-Japanese War began on 9 February 1904. On 9 (22) January 1905 troops fired on the march to the Winter Palace; Bloody Sunday killed about 200 people. On 17 October the revolutionary unrest led him to introduce basic rights and a legislative assembly, the Duma. On 25 April 1906, before the first elected Duma convened, he issued a Fundamental Law; on 3 June 1907 he dissolved the newly elected Duma and restricted the franchise.

heading.en: Entering the war and taking supreme command

body.zh-Hant: 1914年7月30日，奧匈對塞爾維亞宣戰後，尼古拉二世下令全面動員。1915年9月5日，他接掌全軍最高指揮權。總統圖書館的展覽文字稱他是被迫接下最高統帥之職，卻未能使局勢穩定。
body.en: On 30 July 1914, after the Austro-Hungarian declaration of war on Serbia, Nicholas II ordered general mobilisation of the armed forces. On 5 September 1915 he took over supreme command of the armed forces. The Presidential Library exhibition says he was compelled to assume the supreme command, but that this did not stabilise the situation.

body.zh-Hant: 1917年3月15日，尼古拉二世在將領壓力下讓位給弟弟米哈伊爾大公，但米哈伊爾拒絕接受皇位。3月21日他被拘押。1918年7月16日至17日，他與家人在葉卡捷琳堡被布爾什維克殺害；GND記載他的去世日為1918年7月17日。
body.en: On 15 March 1917, under pressure from the generals, Nicholas II abdicated in favour of his brother Grand Duke Michael, who however refused the crown. On 21 March he was taken into custody. On 16-17 July 1918 he and his family were murdered by Bolsheviks in Yekaterinburg; the GND records his date of death as 17 July 1918.
